CUSTOMER SUPPORT / RETENTION — APPLIES TO EVERY VERTICAL
Customer Support
NEW
ALL PRODUCTS · EXISTING PATIENTS
→
What patients call about after they've bought — cancellations, charges, delivery, portal login, side
effects — and what you do in each case. Open topics are marked as such.
Medical Chat — Pending Information
NEW
ALL PRODUCTS · DOSABLE → SUBSCRIPTIONS → PENDING
→
Patients who paid but were never prescribed, because the doctor asked them something and
nobody answered. You get them into their portal to reply — before the 7-day payment hold runs
out.
Renewals — Failed Payment
NEW
ALL PRODUCTS · REFLOW RENEWALS QUEUE
→
Existing patients whose subscription renewal was declined by their bank. Nothing to sell — you
update the card on file and their treatment continues. Includes the step-by-step card update
walkthrough.
